entries.title: A held batch's fix joins the batch instead of opening its own pull request
entries.body: On a project that merges your approved changes in batches, a crewmate repairing a held batch now confirms its fix on its pushed branch, and once the fix is approved it joins that batch. Before, a crewmate that had looked at the batch's pull request first opened a separate pull request for the fix, and the held batch never took it. The same goes for any change whose crewmate looked at another pull request first.
entries.noPicture: No view changes; the difference is which pull requests appear where the project lives and whether the held batch takes the fix.
